messages:
elaine (AE): quick heads-up: Meteor procurement sent an RFI. main asks: POC economics, quantization impact, and whether we can delay license invoicing until production. can we triage?
junaid (SE): yep. their checklist wants qps/latency targets, modeled per-token costs across FP16/int8/int4, and accuracy deltas. i can run a small run on their sample prompts.
marco (SalesEng): are they leaning Dedicated or Private? that changes ops and pricing structure.
elaine (AE): they prefer Private (customer VPC) due to residency. they also asked about HSM/KMS and if we can hold invoicing for 90 days after POC.
lisa (Product): legal usually prefers a partial commitment: e.g., 20% deposit, remainder on go-live or 90 days. i'll paste the standard clause. ops-wise we need a billing-flag in Console and PO number capture.
junaid (SE): for quick reference, here's a compact est matrix (use as a starting point; i'll run their dataset for final numbers):
```
Model | FP16 perf | int8 perf | int4 perf | est cost delta | est acc delta
7B    | 1.0       | 0.6      | 0.4      | -25% / -50%    | -1% / -3%
13B   | 1.0       | 0.65     | 0.45     | -22% / -48%    | -1.5% / -4%
```
these are rough; dataset-specific eval needed.
marco (SalesEng): customer needs a single-page capability matrix for procurement. i'll assemble the RFI attachment if we agree on wording.
elaine (AE): also asked for fallback behavior if quantized model fails quality checks. want explicit rollback language.
lisa (Product): standard fallback: route traffic to FP16 variant in a separate pool, with canary checks and a quality-regression alert that blocks rollout. include SLA note: availability + 95th-latency target; also mention automated regression alerts tied to eval prompt sets.
junaid (SE): action items: 1) i'll run Meteor sample eval (48h). 2) marco to draft POC runbook + deployment diagram. 3) elaine to open Jira + capture commercial deferral ask. 4) lisa to provide legal snippet for deferral and fallback.
marco (SalesEng): i'll aim to drop the capability matrix PDF by EOD tomorrow. will include quant tradeoffs, deployment options (Private/Dedicated), KMS/HSM integrations (AWS KMS, Azure KeyVault, PKCS#11), and billing deferral options.
ops-bot: Reminder: create a POC Jira ticket and attach workload configs. Template: https://redwood-internal/ops/poc-template
elaine (AE): opening REDW-4892 now and will link the Meteor RFI doc.
marco (SalesEng): noted. if legal needs precedent on deferral for Dedicated commits, we have a few earlier deals (30-60 day deferrals with 12mo commits) 12 i'll flag as negotiable but needs RevOps signoff.
elaine (AE): thanks team. i'll loop procurement and cc legal. ping me if any blockers. :thumbsup:
